SRP Difficulty is a [[:Category:Systems|system]] added in [[Version 1.10.0]].
*It has four difficulties: '''Easy''', '''Normal''', '''Hard''' and '''Impossible'''.
**'''Easy mode:''' less knockback immunity. Halved point gain. 
**'''Normal mode:''' No changes.
**'''Hard mode:''' Quadruples (x4) parasites health points, damage and armor. Point gain is multiplied by 1.5 times.
**'''Impossible mode:''' Increases parasite's health and damage by 11 times and armor by 6 times. Adds huge knockback immunity. Point gain multiplied by 10.
Difficulty can be chosen when you are creating new world, by clicking button "SRP World options"
